title: feat(spec, runtime, lint, core): a hook writes the sentences it declares in the organization's language (ctx.text)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Qsbvr2NRYcFNgPCJ7PDjgK)_

Part of #34374

Clause-②: yes (widening) — a hook may now declare `texts` and its code may call `ctx.text`; translation bundles accept `hooks.<hook>.texts.<key>.message`; `@objectstack/core` exports `readOrganizationTextLocale`. Nothing that was accepted before is refused
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #34546

This is the **hook half** of #34374 (ruling 6913660232 option B, parameter 7; split recorded on the card by `repo:objectstack#2`). The **action half is left to PR2**: action-written text (`objects.<obj>._actions.<act>.*` / `globalActions.<act>.*`, e.g. HotCRM's `send_email` script action writing `'Email: ' + subject`) lands after #34273 merges, reuses #34273's shared declared-entry factory, starts from fresh main, and is the PR that closes the card. This PR does not touch `action.zod.ts`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：钩子可以声明自己写进记录给人读的句子（`texts`），运行时用 `await ctx.text('key', { … })` 取，按**组织语言**给出（Localization 设置有人设过就用它，否则应用的 `i18n.defaultLocale`），从不按触发保存的那个人的语言。
- 为什么改：HotCRM 的线索/工单钩子把「Follow up with qualified lead: …」这类英文句子写进任务标题，中文、日文组织里大家读到的都是英文；裁定 B 第 7 项要求和已声明的钩子拒绝语同一规则。
- 风险与回滚：纯新增，未声明 `texts` 的钩子行为不变；缺译文写声明原文，不失败；只有 Localization 设置读不出来（非「未注册」）时那次 `ctx.text` 拒绝。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-text.ts`（取语言、选译文、填洞），然后 `packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts` 的 `texts` 与保存期检查。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/sandbox/hook-text.integration.test.ts`，预期 11 条全过（返工后加了「译文渲染不了回落到声明句」在两条路径上各 1 条）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地；动作一半在 PR2（等 #34273 合并）。

## What changes

- **Spec — `HookSchema.texts`** (`packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts`, `hook-refusal-codes.ts`): a hook declares `texts: { <snake_case key>: { message, params? } }`. `params` names the `{{ }}` holes, under the same closed-scope rule a declared refusal's message follows; a text with no `params` is plain and a hole in it is refused. Save-time checks: `texts` on an `expression` body or on a hook with neither body nor handler is refused at `texts`; a `ctx.text('<literal>')` key the hook does not declare is refused at `body.source` / `handler` (comments and strings are masked; a computed key is left to the run).
- **Spec — translation face** (`i18n-resolver.ts`, `translation.zod.ts`): the key is `hooks.<hook>.texts.<key>.message` (`hookTextMessageKey`); the translation bundle's `hooks.<hook>` group accepts `texts`.
- **Core — one reading of the organization's language** (`packages/core/src/organization-locale.ts`): `readOrganizationTextLocale(getService, organizationId)` — the Localization setting somebody set (`source !== 'default'`), else the app's `i18n.defaultLocale`, else nothing. An unregistered Localization namespace/key (`SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE` / `SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_KEY`) is "not set"; any other read failure propagates. The flow record write (`service-automation`) used its own private copy of exactly this; it now calls the shared one, answers unchanged.
- **Runtime — `ctx.text(key, params?)`** (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-text.ts`, `body-runner.ts`, `quickjs-runner.ts`, `script-runner.ts`, `app-artifact-handlers.ts`): translate the template first (through the `i18n` service, negotiated as refusals are), then fill the holes through the formula template engine (`renderHookTemplate`, shared with the refusal filler, which keeps its behaviour). A missing translation answers the declared `message`; a translation whose holes do not render is dropped for the declared `message`, filled, with a warning that says so; an undeclared key throws a `SandboxError` naming the hook and the key. Same answer on a sandboxed `js` body (installed on the VM's `ctx`) and an in-process `handler` (the `withInProcessHookTitle` seam).
- **Lint** (`i18n-walk.ts`, `validate-translation-references.ts`, `validate-hook-refusal-templates.ts`): `os i18n extract` scaffolds `hooks.<hook>.texts.<key>.message` with the declared sentence; `objectstack validate` refuses a `hooks.<hook>.texts.<key>` translation over a key the hook does not declare (nearest key offered). The compile half of a hook sentence (#33214) now judges `texts.<key>.message` for an entry with `params` beside the refusal sentences: logic, an unknown formatter, an empty hole and `currency` with no code are errors at `objectstack validate`, `compile` and the publish gate's `hook` write.
- **Docs**: `automation/hooks.mdx` (new section), `automation/hook-bodies.mdx` (`ctx.text` row), `ui/translations.mdx` (key row).
- **Generated**: dropped-refinements baseline (the new `HookText` object-level check and the `texts.valueType` sites), liveness rows (`hook.texts`, `translation.hooks.texts`), and the `check:generated --fix` outputs (api-surface, export-origins, declaration-map, reference docs, strictness ledger, liveness counts, and the two generator-owned `skills/*/references/_index.md` lines that list `HookTextSchema`).

Not changed: no backfill of rows already written (parameter 6); no `org.locale` root (parameter 8); a string a hook builds itself is written as it is (parameter 4).

## Tests

- **`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-text.integration.test.ts`** (new): the HotCRM lead follow-up shape on the real `ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3) + `QuickJSScriptRunner` + in-memory `i18n`, on **both** the sandboxed body and the in-process handler path, every assertion on the stored task row. An en-US caller in a zh-CN app writes the zh-CN translation, holes filled; a ja-JP Localization setting somebody set wins and is asked in the write's organization (CONTROL: the `source: 'default'` placeholder does not count); no translation writes the declared sentence filled; `SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_KEY` answers the app default while `SETTINGS_STORE_UNAVAILABLE` rejects the update with no task written; an undeclared key rejects naming hook and key; a translation whose holes do not render writes the declared sentence filled and warns so (CONTROL: a translation that renders, with a known formatter, is written).
- **`packages/spec/src/data/hook-texts.test.ts`** (new): schema acceptance, key pattern, hole rules, alias, expression-body / no-code refusal, handler acceptance, literal undeclared key at `body.source` and `handler`, masked-comment/string/computed-key CONTROL, run-time message, translation face, key spelling.
- **`packages/core/src/organization-locale.test.ts`**: `readOrganizationTextLocale` — set wins in the organization; no settings / placeholder → app default; unregistered namespace/key → app default; other failure rejects; no lookup → nothing.
- **`packages/lint/src/validate-hook-refusal-templates.test.ts`**: a hook text with `params` — CONTROLs accepted (a path, a known formatter, `currency:EUR`, plain text); an unknown formatter, logic and an empty hole refused as errors at `texts.<key>.message`; `currency` with no code refused naming `currency:EUR`; a text with no `params` not read; a text and a refusal on one hook each at its own path; part of the stack expression pass; refused at the publish gate's `hook` write (CONTROL passes).
- **`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts`**, **`i18n-walk.test.ts`**: declared text passes; undeclared key refused with suggestion; key on a hook with no `texts` refused; the walk yields the key with the declared sentence from the `hook` bucket.
- **Forced test changes**: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts` (`hook` serves 24 top-level properties, was 23); `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` (a root ledger row for `hook.texts`); `packages/spec/src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` pins `HookTextSchema` as an isomorphic alias (ADR-0122; no default, no transform, beside `HookRefusalSchema`) and moves the pin count by one (857 after merging main, which added two). No other existing test was changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Action half → PR2** (after #34273), as above.
- The Studio hook form (`hook.form.ts`) gets no `texts` row in this PR: adding one needs its labels and help text translated in the eleven metadata-forms bundles, which is outside this half's file surface. The form↔Zod reconciliation records the omission as a root ledger row, owed to a follow-up card. A hook authored in Studio can still carry `texts` through its source. Filed: #34575.
- `ctx.text` is a pull API rather than a write-time marker because the HotCRM hooks truncate and compose the sentence (both cut to 255 characters) before writing it.
- New public names, confirmed by the seat: `texts`, `ctx.text`, `HookTextSchema`, `hookTextMessageKey`. `readOrganizationTextLocale` is kept because its reading differs from main's `readOrganizationLocaleSetting` (it is built on it, not beside it); its JSDoc carries the side-by-side table below.

  | the Localization setting answers… | `readOrganizationLocaleSetting` | `readOrganizationTextLocale` |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | set (`source: 'tenant'`, `ja-JP`) | `ja-JP` | `ja-JP` |
  | the `source: 'default'` placeholder | `undefined` | the app default (`zh-CN`) |
  | no settings service | `undefined` | the app default (`zh-CN`) |
  | `SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_KEY` | rejects | the app default (`zh-CN`) |
  | `SETTINGS_STORE_UNAVAILABLE` | rejects | rejects |

  Read by a probe at head over both exports (app default `zh-CN`, organization `org_1`). The flow record write's private copy of the second column (`service-automation`) is gone; the seed loader keeps the first.
- Needs a contract-tier review (`Metadata-protocol: added`).

## Verification

Every heavy run went under `os-verify-lock`.

- Head 7b8d110d merges main d57d6eed through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (merge 5e336193, then the regeneration commit 7b8d110d). `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json` conflicted only in its `measured` header (main 268 / 1116, this PR +1 schema / +6 sites) and was recomputed from the merged body, 269 / 1122; `authorable-surface/data.json` and `content/docs/references/data/hook.mdx` were regenerated from the merged tree (`gen:schema`, `gen:docs`) rather than text-merged. After the merge: `check:generated` 14/14; `@objectstack/spec` tests 848 files, 27168 passed; `@objectstack/lint` 214 files, 9107 passed; runtime sandbox + app-artifact-handlers 52 files, 649 passed; spec, lint and runtime `typecheck` exit 0 (runtime's first run was red on a stale local `driver-turso` build, green after rebuilding it). `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 34545` at 7b8d110d: "0 of 48 path(s) hit the register after 2 generated-artifact lift(s) (13 surfaces govern objectstack). ✅ NOT governed". Outside the baseline and the generated docs and surface, this PR's diff against main is line-for-line the one reviewed at 8929099e (`git diff 31096af8 8929099e` against `git diff d57d6eed 7b8d110d`, same changed lines).
- Head 8929099e is L1 rework round 1 (review 6937770388), plus a merge of main 31096af8:
  - Item 1: `validate-hook-refusal-templates.ts` judges hook texts; `hook-text.ts` falls back from a translation that does not render to the declared `message`, filled. `@objectstack/lint` `validate-hook-refusal-templates.test.ts` 24/24; runtime `hook-text.integration.test.ts` + hook-refusal suites 49/49.
  - Ablations (restored, `git diff` empty after each): the lint pass skipping `texts` ⇒ 7 of 24 red (every refusal case, the stack pass and the publish gate; the 4 CONTROLs and the no-`params` case stay green). The run-time fallback writing the unrendered translation ⇒ 2 of 11 red (the new case, both paths).
  - `HookTextSchema.params`, its JSDoc, `automation/hooks.mdx` and the changeset now say where each hole is refused (parse, or `os validate` / `compile` / the publish gate). The liveness row `hook.texts.params` is re-anchored at `renderHookTemplate`.
  - Merge of main 31096af8: the alias pin count resolves to 857 (main 854 → 856, this PR +1), with both history lines; `gen:schema` and `gen:docs` exit 0; `check:generated` failed `check:liveness` on its first run (the `hook.texts.params` citation named the replaced filler) and passed 14/14 after the re-anchor above.
  - Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 129 families at 8929099e; all 129 ran: 128 exit 0, and `check:skill-examples` exit 3 on a stale `@objectstack/client` dist (nothing measured), exit 0 on its rerun after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/client build`.
  - `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 34545` at 8929099e, in a built tree: "governed-surface predicate: 0 of 48 path(s) hit the register after 2 generated-artifact lift(s) (13 surfaces govern objectstack). ✅ NOT governed". Both `skills/*/references/_index.md` lines read as a pure `gen:skill-refs` regeneration on this tree (#11705).

- `@objectstack/runtime` sandbox + app-artifact-handlers suites: 10 files, 308 passed (the hook-text pin 9/9 again at head). `@objectstack/core` `organization-locale.test.ts`: 10 passed. `@objectstack/lint` walk + translation references: 255 passed. `@objectstack/service-automation`: 286 files, 4076 passed. `@objectstack/spec` hook texts + hook refusals: 113 passed.
- Typecheck (`tsc --noEmit`) of core, runtime, lint, service-automation: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 14/14 green after `--fix`; `check:test-typecheck` green.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): replace the translation pick in `hook-text.ts` with `undefined` ⇒ 6 of 9 integration tests red (every translated-language pin, both paths); the 3 that stay green are the missing-translation fallback (both paths) and the undeclared-key refusal, which read no translation.
- Head df9ac15c merges main 8dd8192c. `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json` conflicted only in its `measured` header (main moved sites 1090 → 1114, this PR 1090 → 1096); the header was recomputed from the merged body, 267 schemas / 1120 sites, and `authorable-surface/data.json` was regenerated with `gen:schema`. After the merge: `check:generated` exit 0; `@objectstack/spec` local tests 848 files, 27148 passed; runtime sandbox + app-artifact-handlers 52 files, 647 passed; runtime and service-automation `typecheck` exit 0 (runtime's first run was red on a stale local `driver-turso` build, green after rebuilding it).
- Head 70a4381b fixes `Test Core (2/8)` at aae87d70: `scripts/dropped-refinements.test.ts` checks that the ledger's `measured` header totals equal its body. The hand-edited rows for `HookText` and the four hook `texts.valueType` sites were added, but the header still read 266 schemas / 1090 sites; it now reads 267 / 1096. `@objectstack/spec` local project: 847 files, 1 failed before the fix (this test), 27/27 in the file after.
- Head aae87d70 fixes three red CI checks at d4e652a0:
  - `Type Check · workspace`: the new pin imported `EngineInsertOptions`, which `@objectstack/spec/data` does not export; it now names `DataEngineInsertOptions`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` (with `check:test-typecheck`) exit 0; core, lint and service-automation `typecheck` exit 0.
  - `Test Core (2/8)`: `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` refused `texts` as accepted by the Zod but not offered by the hook form. A root ledger row (`omit`, `hook`, `texts`) now records why: the Studio row is owed to a follow-up (see Acceptance notes). 76/76.
  - `Test Core (6/8)`: `protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts` pins the top-level property count `/meta/types` serves; `hook` 23 → 24 for `texts`, with its history line. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: 355 files, 1 failed before the fix (this pin), 18/18 in the file after.
  - Affected gates rerun: `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:slot-lookup`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:type-check-debt` exit 0; `check:generated` exit 1 on a first run beside a concurrent build and exit 0 on a second run.
- Head d4e652a0: the changeset's `Clause-②` line now reads `yes (widening)`, matching `Metadata-protocol: added` (CI `Check Changeset` refused `no` beside `added`). `check-empty-changeset` and `check:changeset-fixed` exit 0.
- Head a3a4bb58 merges main 107d2e84. GitHub read the PR as conflicting because both sides moved the generated schema counts in `content/docs/references/index.mdx` (this PR +1 in Data, main +1 in UI), and GitHub does not use the repo's merge driver for generated artifacts. The local merge applied that driver. Resolution: `gen:docs` on the merged tree (1667 schemas: Data 188, UI 177), then `check:generated` 14/14 and `check:docs` exit 0. `check-governed-merges --pr 34545`: NOT governed, and both `skills/*/references/_index.md` lines are a pure `gen:skill-refs` regeneration on this tree (#11705).
- Head 7bebb376 (35212cf2 plus a JSDoc table on `readOrganizationTextLocale` and the `Skills-docs` line in the changeset): core `organization-locale.test.ts` 10 passed and `tsc --noEmit` exit 0; the same 129-family derivation, of which the 26 changeset/docs/core families reran with exit 0. At 35212cf2, merged with main after branching from e8cba8fe. Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 129 families; all 129 ran with exit 0 at this head, and `--ran` reports 129 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. On the first round `check:query-options-erasure` caught two erased options bags in the new pin (now typed) and `check:spec-parsed-alias` asked for the `HookTextSchema` pin (added); the exit-3 prerequisites (shallow clone, unbuilt `client-react` and other dists) were built and every family rerun.
